calibration.explicit_quantum_preparation: Use both copies of the 32-dimensional word space in the normalized state sum_w |w,w>/sqrt(32). The raw operators are diagonal with eigenvalues (-1)^(w_e+s_e). Flip the displayed auxiliary only at the listed occurrence. Equivalently draw one of the listed raw hidden words uniformly before both questions.

output_code: Bits in integer words are placed from low to high in the holder's listed order; 8 is failure.
